provenance.twin: twin v2: 100 ms step, per-RE RSRP (n78 100 MHz, 273 PRB), RS-SINR with 50% interferer load, Doppler-correlated fading (2-branch diversity), 3GPP RLF (Qout -8 dB / Qin -6 dB, N310=2, T310=1 s), HO failure on source-command loss or target SINR < Qout, 1 s re-establishment; CHO executions skip command loss
provenance.eval_seeds: 2100-2119 (pre-registered held-out; used once). v3.1.1 lineage: central init v3.39.0 trained on fit seeds 31000-31003 (early-stopping validation 31100-31101); federation clients on 4-seed prefixes of the pre-registered blocks (620-623, 720-723, 820-823); baseline sweep 500-504; candidate selection on tuning seeds 1000-1019; gate 1100-1102. Audit seeds 31200-31219 unused.
provenance.pairing: all arms run on identical radio traces per (cell, seed), one sim pass per trace
provenance.ci_method: 95% Student-t CI of the mean over episodes; paired-difference tests in working/evidence/finals-v3/report.md
provenance.baselines: oracle (knows the scenario x fading cell): a3_tuned, cho_tuned (sweep 500-504), cho_tuned_ext (extended grid, sweep 500-504); deployable (one network-wide setting): a3_global, cho_global, cho_global_ext, cho_mse (3GPP mobility-state scaling; equals cho_global in this run), cho_mro (MRO online offsets)
provenance.policy_arm: v1.3.1 (the promoted live policy) remains the policy arm, as frozen in FREEZE.md and the pre-registration. It has NO held-out data in this run and none is shown or invented. The evaluated candidate v3.1.1 (clean median-federated MLP CHO-profile selector, OpenCelliD, not runtime-qualified) is shown only as the extra research arm `v3_research`; its pre-registered verdict is NO-GO.

evaluated_candidate.selection: clean-candidates-only reading of the pre-registered rule, disclosed in FREEZE.md
